question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**entered**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the fourth blank is 'entered'.
 
• The given passage is about the creation of superheroes in Indian comics. It mentions various characters and publishers who have contributed to the Indian comic book industry.
 
• The word "**entered**" is the appropriate choice here because it refers to the act of joining or becoming involved in a particular area or field. In this case, Raj comics entered the superhero comic book genre with its own characters.
 
• The other options, "**invaded**", "**penetrated**", and "**pierced**", have more negative connotations and suggest forceful entry or intrusion. "**Entered**" is a more neutral and appropriate word to describe Raj comics' introduction into the genre.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

Correct *Passage*:__ *Comics have (1) __produced__ many superheroes. Bantul, the great was (2) __created__ in the year 1965 in the backdrop of the Indo-Pak war. Indrajal comics was set up in 1964 and (3) __employed__ Aabid Surti, who gave birth to a character called Bhadur in 1976 wearing kurta and jeans. Raj comics too **(4) **__**entered**__ into this sphere with their (5) ________ toons Nagraj, Tiranga and Shakti together called Brahman Rakshak (protectors of the universe).*
